purpose: Review of P-0002 (lone species-C free flight, specular walls, T=40) at a different start and direction from its evidence (2026-11-17/r2/lab-b/005, from (1,1) with v=(3,2)). Lone C from (3,4) with v=(-2.4,2.8), speed 3.69, T=40, dt=0.1, so the particle makes several wall reflections on both axes. Falsified if the paper's own reflected-line predictor has tracker RMSE above 0.06 per coordinate (noise 0.05) over the run, or the mean residual drifts beyond 0.05 over any 10-unit segment.
